title: CoreWeave stock is at risk of hitting record lows as AI funding starts drying
description: CoreWeave stock has been under intense pressure in the past few months, and this weakness may continue in the coming weeks as funding for artificial intelligence (AI) companies dries. It dropped to $54.87, down by over 70% from its peak. It has formed the alarming head-and-shoulders pattern, pointing to a bearish breakout in the near term. AI funding is drying up There are signs that investors are getting jittery about funding companies in the artificial intelligence industry. Firmus, an Australian company, recently pulled its initial public offering as investors pushed back against its $30 billion valuation. The most notable red flag came out recently after OpenAI, a top CoreWeave client, raised just $11 billion. While the amount was huge, it…
